title: Small bug fix: cart total ignores quantity

steps.request: Bug: the cart total is wrong when a line has more than one of an item. Adding two coffees at $3.50 shows a total of $3.50 instead of $7.00. Please fix it and add a regression test.

acceptance: cartTotal multiplies each line's price by its quantity
Totals stay rounded to cents (e.g. 3 x 0.1 = 0.3)
Existing behaviour (empty cart, single items) unchanged
A regression test exists and npm test passes
